name: Loading route residents
title: Loading residents…
description: Keep filters available; disable billing until data arrives. Announce loading once. If it fails, show the retry state.
behavior: Keep filters available; disable billing until data arrives. Announce loading once. If it fails, show the retry state.

name: First-use empty route
title: No residents on this route yet
description: Add a resident or import a list to start building your delivery run.
behavior: Show only after a successful empty response. Do not show zero balances while loading. Secondary action: Import residents.

name: No search results
title: No matching residents
description: No results for “Lotus 99” in R01. Try another name or clear your filters.
behavior: Preserve the search text and selected route. Clearing search and filters restores the list; an empty result is not an error.

name: API failure with retry
title: We couldn’t load this route
description: Your route and October billing period are saved. Check the connection and try again.
behavior: Retry the same request. Show last-synced data only with a timestamp; never present stale totals as current.

name: Offline field updates
title: You’re offline · 3 updates waiting
description: Delivery updates are saved on this device and will sync when you reconnect.
behavior: Keep local updates visible as Pending sync. Financial actions requiring server confirmation remain unavailable.

name: Sync in progress
title: Syncing 3 delivery updates…
description: Prevent duplicate submission. Mark each item synced only after acknowledgement; retain failed items for retry.
behavior: Prevent duplicate submission. Mark each item synced only after acknowledgement; retain failed items for retry.

name: Concurrent edit conflict
title: This bill changed elsewhere
description: Another operator saved a newer version of DB-2026-1048. Review both versions before continuing.
behavior: Preserve local edits. Compare current server values with your changes; do not overwrite automatically or create a second invoice.

name: Session expired
title: Sign in to continue
description: Your session expired. Your unsaved bill stays on this device while you sign in again.
behavior: After authentication, return to the same route, resident and period. Recheck permissions and server version before saving.

name: Invalid delivered quantity
title: Check delivered quantities
description: The Hindu · Daily: −1 copies. Enter a whole number from 0 to 30 for the selected delivery dates.
behavior: Show the error beside the quantity field and focus the first invalid field. Keep all other input; Save bill remains disabled.

name: Missing or conflicting rate
title: A delivery rate needs review
description: The Hindu has no confirmed rate for 14–15 October. Resolve the effective date range before generating this bill.
behavior: Do not silently treat missing rates as ₹0. Show the affected dates and precedence: resident agreement, date override, standard rate.

name: Duplicate bill
title: This period already has a bill
description: DB-2026-1048 already covers Anitha Nair’s October deliveries.
behavior: Check resident, period and covered delivery dates. Open the existing bill; do not create a duplicate when Save is clicked twice.

name: Unsaved edits
title: Leave this bill without saving?
description: Your delivery quantity and credit changes have not been saved.
behavior: Secondary action: Discard changes. Escape and clicking outside keep the editor open. Restore focus to the invoking control.

name: Partial payment
title: Record a partial payment
description:
Anitha Nair · DB-2026-1048
Amount due ₹661.00 · Received ₹200.00
Balance after payment ₹461.00
behavior: Require method and receipt details. After confirmation show Partially paid, receipt ID and remaining ₹461; keep route position.

name: Overpayment
title: Payment exceeds the balance
description:
Amount entered ₹700.00 · Due ₹661.00
Extra ₹39.00 needs an explicit decision.
behavior: Default: correct the amount. Only offer ₹39 account credit if the agency supports it and the operator confirms; never silently change the payment.

name: Submission in progress
title: Recording ₹661 payment…
description: Disable the submit action and use one request identity. The bill remains unpaid until confirmation returns.
behavior: Disable the submit action and use one request identity. The bill remains unpaid until confirmation returns.

name: Payment outcome unknown
title: We’re checking this payment
description: The connection dropped before confirmation. The payment may already be recorded.
behavior: Look up the original request or receipt before enabling another payment. Never say “No payment recorded” unless the server confirms failure.

name: Overlapping vacation hold
title: These hold dates overlap
description: Joseph Mathew already has a hold from 01–04 Nov. Your new hold starts on 03 Nov.
behavior: Show affected publications and inclusive dates. Offer merge or date adjustment; each delivery date is excluded from dispatch and billing once.

name: Route without assigned staff
title: R01 needs a delivery operator
description: Biju P. is unavailable for this run. Assign a substitute before confirming dispatch.
behavior: Keep stops and delivery order. Do not mark the route dispatched until an eligible operator is assigned; retain the assignment history.

name: Delivery update failed
title: Delivery update wasn’t saved
description: Fathima Ali · Drop 004 is still marked Missed delivery. Your redelivery note is preserved.
behavior: Retain the entered note and original delivery date. Do not issue a credit or count a redelivery until the chosen action is confirmed.

name: End of collection run
title: You’ve reached the last resident
description: R01 collection review is complete. Some accounts may still have unpaid balances.
behavior: Replace Move to next with View route summary. Show paid, partial, skipped and remaining totals; never imply every resident has paid.

name: Restricted action
title: You don’t have access to close cash
description: Your current role can view the ledger. An agency administrator can approve cash closing.
behavior: Explain the required permission. Preserve readable context; do not reveal or enable restricted actions after a failed permission check.

name: Export failure
title: Ledger export failed
description: Your ledger is unchanged. Retry the export with the same date range and filters.
behavior: Keep date, route and payment-method filters. Show progress during generation and a clear downloadable result after success.

name: Print or share unavailable
title: The bill is saved · sharing failed
description: DB-2026-1048 is ready. We couldn’t open the sharing service.
behavior: Keep invoice status Saved. Offer download or retry sharing; do not regenerate or mark the bill paid because sharing failed.

name: Preference save failure
title: Preferences couldn’t be saved
description: Your preview is still visible. Retry to save Teal & Turquoise and your reading size to this workspace.
behavior: Keep the preview and edited values. Secondary action: Restore saved preferences. Do not show “Preferences saved” until confirmed.
